name: 補過左耳的布兔
caption: 耳朵媽媽補好了。她還在等我們來找她。
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one close-up evidence photograph for a Taiwanese folk-horror game, landscape3:2. Meticulously realistic physical object, tactile worn materials, shallow but sufficient depth of field with key clues all in focus, practical flashlight and muted amber spill, damp abandoned Taiwanese mountain temple in2026, grounded documentary photography. Suspense from concrete evidence rather than monsters. One coherent photograph, not collage or split panels. No captions, no UI, no watermark, no extraneous lettering. Keep important object well exposed and complete in frame. Subject: Inside an opened aged oilcloth bundle on mossy stone under a Taiwanese banyan tree: ONE small handmade faded red cotton rabbit with crooked repaired LEFT ear, tiny dense neat red-thread stitches, button eyes, cloth label clearly embroidered '林小雨'. Under rabbit ONE small red cloth Mary Jane child's shoe filled with dry incense ash, a corner of torn squared school exercise paper under insole. Only objects, no child or body. Gentle heartbreaking detail, dawnless night with warm flashlight, not graphic horror. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: This must be a frightening NIGHT-TIME location photograph, NOT a clean studio product shot or daytime illustration. Background falls into deep near-black darkness, only a narrow off-camera FLASHLIGHT beam with faint dying candle spill reveals the evidence. Surroundings ancient, neglected, water-damaged, cracked wood, mold, cobwebs, grime, realistic soot. Low-key cold desaturated green-black shadows, dirty muted amber highlights. Claustrophobic, unsettling horror-film realism, fine believable materials. No sunshine, bright window, white studio backdrop, glossy showroom, excessive fog hiding clues, or comic illustration. Keep clue readable in the flashlight pool; do not underexpose the key object.
